reasoning_content:
Now run the backend inside the devcontainer. The devcontainer has /workspace mounted. But the compose config mounts /workspace as cached volume. The devcontainer's node_modules is same as host's? It's the same bind mount from host. Yes since ../../../../:/workspace. So node_modules is shared.

But database hostname resolves in devcontainer. Good. Let me run backend there.

action.command: docker exec -d startuphafen-devcontainer bash -lc 'cd /workspace/dist/apps/startuphafen-backend && /opt/node22/bin/node main.js > /tmp/backend.log 2>&1'; sleep 40; docker exec startuphafen-devcontainer bash -lc 'tail -15 /tmp/backend.log; timeout 3 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5000" && echo "5000 open" || echo "5000 closed"'
